data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 公寓厨房的细致熬汤
data.description: 暖意融融的公寓厨房里，炉灶上的汤锅正咕嘟咕嘟冒着热气，飘散着日式高汤的浓郁香气。系着围裙的雪菜单手持木勺尝过汤汁，微微侧过身来，清澈褐眸带着满心期待与害羞。她用另一只手轻护在勺下，将木勺递到你唇边示意尝尝咸淡，神态洋溢着新婚妻子般的体贴与柔情。
data.location: 暖光温馨的公寓厨房料理台
data.action: 侧身手执木勺向前递送喂食，另一手虚托勺底温声示意
data.lighting: 抽油烟机料理暖光与客厅温馨灯火
data.camera: 第一人称喂饭视角中近景，木勺水汽与娇俏面庞特写
data.promptProse: Inside a cozy modern kitchen filled with delicious culinary steam, Yukina stands cooking beside a bubbling stove. Wearing a warm knit sweater beneath a cute kitchen apron, she gracefully offers a wooden soup spoon toward the viewer with one hand while cupping her other hand beneath it. Her cheeks blush with earnest wifely pride and sweet affection as she asks for a taste test.
data.animaCaption: Offering a wooden spoon of soup toward the viewer in the warm kitchen, smiling affectionately in her apron and sweater.
